label: boundary_change
question: Among the dated events in the timeline, list in time order the occasions on which a district or island part was separated from Stord or added to it.
why_needs_multiple: Four separate boundary-change events must be combined into one list.
criterion: A part of territory was separated from Stord or added to Stord (a municipal boundary change). The founding of the municipality is not a boundary change.

gold_events.text: Northern district separated from Stord to form Fitjar municipality.
Southern mainland district separated to form Valestrand municipality.
Southern part of Huglo island transferred from Fjelberg to Stord.
Uninhabited part of Stord island transferred from Bømlo to Stord.

question: Among the dated events in the timeline, list in time order the occasions on which a mayor of Stord left office.
why_needs_multiple: Three separate end-of-term events must be combined into one list.
criterion: A mayor of Stord's term of office ended (the mayor left office).

gold_events.text: Magne Rommetveit ends term as mayor of Stord.
Liv Kari Eskeland ends term as mayor of Stord.
Harry Herstad ends term as mayor of Stord.

question: After Liv Kari Eskeland began her term as mayor of Stord, who was the next person to begin a term as mayor among the dated events in the timeline?
why_needs_multiple: The answer requires ordering the take-office events and identifying the one immediately after the anchor.
criterion: A person began a term as mayor of Stord (took office as mayor).
